name: q2
description: A modern, self-hosted collaborative workspace for WordPress.

scripts.check: npm run test:unit -- --runInBand && npm run lint:js && npm run lint:style && composer lint
scripts.i18n:update: wp i18n make-pot . languages/q2.pot --domain=q2 --exclude=build,dist,node_modules,vendor --headers='{"Report-Msgid-Bugs-To":"https://github.com/plakio/q2/issues"}' && wp i18n update-po languages/q2.pot languages/q2-es_ES.po
scripts.i18n:build: wp i18n make-mo languages && wp i18n make-json languages languages --no-purge --use-map=scripts/i18n-map.json
